Table S1: Table S1. Composition of the benchmark. Cells of the Monte Carlo grids are defined by realised sizes. Table S2: Table S2. Effect of the training design on the mean bias (A) and the MAE (B). Pairing pool: fold-restricted minus in-sample (same fit, pairs formed within folds); outcome leakage: k-fold minus fold-restricted (same pairing pool, similarity learned without the evaluated fold); leave-one-physician-out and external: difference with in-sample. Unsupervised methods do not learn from the outcome, so their leakage, leave-one-physician-out and external effects are zero by construction. Genetic Mahalanobis was cross-fitted on the SCORE2 experiment only. n: number of experiments (SCORE2, progressive and continuous-heterogeneity experiments with the design).
